name: io.github.ni-c/hetzner-dns-mcp
title: Hetzner DNS
description: Manage DNS zones and records (zonefiles, RRSets, TTL, protection) via the Hetzner Cloud API

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Hetzner Cloud API token (project-scoped, Cloud Console -> Security -> API tokens)

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read-only tools (default: false)

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Hetzner Cloud API base URL (default: https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1)
